metrics.scope: Since latest host load. JSON encode includes stringify/TextEncoder; copy_in covers WASM allocation/copy; abi includes the synchronous WASM request and its internal serialization, not GPU execution; response_decode covers readObservation copy/TextDecoder/JSON parse. Setup includes executor creation/configuration; configure_ms overlaps bridge configure timings. Excludes project load, Worker messaging, caller application and report cloning. Failed request metrics include only phases reached.
